intro: Hi, I'm Jared Walters. I am a senior supply chain management major at Rutgers Business School. My career interests and experience in supply chain management include logistics, demand planning, procurement, inventory management, and analytics.
My interests focus on supply chain management, operations, finance, and data analytics. I enjoy leveraging data visualization and analytical tools to turn information into clear, actionable insights.
